ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-grey) distribution across >90% of the visible ventral surface, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized exclusively to distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation field across both lobes; distinct high-contrast white geometric clusters (barnacle colonies) are mapped to the extreme lateral margins of the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression; calculated pixel angle approximately 75 degrees; well-defined sharp apex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire trailing boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies from 5 to 15 pixels; serrations are more acute on the distal halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep originating from the median notch and terminating in sharply tapered, upwardly-curved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of roughly circular, high-intensity white pixel groups visible on the outer margins of both left and right lobe tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization located on the distal tips of both fluke lobes.
